answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The lotus is the attested output, the glacier the stranger who checks it, and the vault the tier the pair unlocks; the lotus is per identity, the glacier cannot be the farm's own, and the vault is what waiting alone cannot buy.
